instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot. At an outdoor wedding venue at night, the groom in the white embroidered sherwani (R1) stands on the left, looking down affectionately at his bride with a smile. The bride in the red bridal lehenga (R2) stands on the right, leaning her head gently onto his shoulder with a serene, smiling expression. The background is softly out of focus, showing warm decorative lights and structures. The lighting is warm and festive, casting a soft glow on the couple.
